item.title: [IGNITE-10582] MVCC: Error on txLog initialization.
item.description:
A sporadic error occurs during txLog initialization. Reproducer: IgnitePdsCacheAssignmentNodeRestartsTest#testAssignmentAfterRestarts. This error may be the result of the test settings. We need to check it more carefully.
